$comment: Reviewed, intentional differences from the golden baseline, read by tests/e2e/route-inventory.spec.ts. Only soft fields can be approved: description, keywords, og:title, og:description, og:image:alt, og:site_name, og:locale, og:type, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image:alt. Shape: routes["/path"]["field"] = { "value": "exact new text" | null (removed), "reason": "why" }. Hard fields (title, canonical, og:url, robots, OG image, anchors, JSON-LD coverage, EnquiryRouter intent, print hooks, headers, sitemap order, redirects) cannot be approved here. An approval that matches the baseline again fails as stale. The top-level "visible" list is a review log, not read by the tests: every intentional change to visible page copy, link targets or a recorded deviation from the design spec, as { routes, change, reason }.

visible.change: Rebuilt as the approved Apple-style page: typographic hero ("Built for Tanzania. Built to last." two-tone, with "Meet the companies" and "Read the company profile"), the group structure as an SVG tier diagram, a "Why diversification?" bento, a 2012–2025 milestones strip, leadership cards, the head office tile and the closing call to action. The "Who we are" chapter (h2 "A multi-industry business ecosystem") and its four-photo mosaic are gone; its conglomerate model now leads the structure chapter.
visible.reason: P1: plan "Pages › About"; the old page had no body links and repeated forecourt photographs (critic).

visible.change: Group structure: the monospace ASCII tree and the emoji tier icons are replaced by nested lists with SVG connectors. Units are listed one per brand (ITEMBA-MPEMBA and ITEMBA-UZUNGUNI split), and "Wholesale beverages" (Westsides) plus "Itemba Estate" and "Emerging businesses" (Itemba Enterprises) are added from src/content/companies.ts sites; the Brands tier is "Brands and businesses" with a rewritten summary, and the Companies tier summary reads "each with its own identity, focus and market".
visible.reason: P1: plan "a group-structure diagram (clean SVG tiers)"; the tree now matches each company page's "Brands and sites" and the core message (Enterprises: logistics, emerging businesses and Itemba Estate).

visible.change: Structure lede: "Each company is legally and operationally independent, with strategy, shared resources and governance from the group." replaces the conglomerate paragraph; the "four specialised divisions" sentence is not shown.
visible.reason: P1: the long paragraph ran four lines on desktop and six on a phone; the divisions count is unconfirmed (flags.showDivisionsStat defaults to false).

visible.change: "Why diversification?" gains a lede ("Six sectors under one structure, so no single market decides the group’s future."), a six-sector row linking each service page, and a "6 Business sectors" figure; the Revenue diversification pillar drops "manufacturing".
visible.reason: P1: plan bento; flags.mentionManufacturing defaults to false (no manufacturing offering exists).

visible.change: New milestones strip ("Our story" / "Built step by step, since 2012."): seven years summarising the nine company-history entries, in chronological order (2 May 2017, 9 June 2017, then "2017 onward").
visible.reason: P1: plan "timeline (2012 to 2025) as an Apple-style horizontal milestones strip"; the profile history lists "2017 onward" before 9 June 2017.

visible.change: New leadership chapter ("The team behind the group."): the five company-profile leaders as typographic cards with no portraits, gated by flags.publishLegalIdentifiers.
visible.reason: P1: plan "leadership as typographic cards (no fake avatars)"; the names are already published on /company-profile and in the PDFs.
